notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Lumbering Battlement.
description:
Activate Lumbering Battlement by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering Felidar Guardian's ability, Lumbering Battlement's ability, and Deadeye Navigator's ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.
